title: Workers popup follow-ups: anchor it to the count, keyboard pane links, live refresh
notes: Left over from PR #176. (1) The workers list opens in the shared search dialog; the user asked for a small popup anchored to the count in the status line. (2) dashboard://pane links work by mouse only; reach them from the keyboard like other transcript links. (3) The count does not refresh when a worker's agent exits until the next hook mark or pane change. (4) The done report does not carry the worker's last message. (5) pane claim prints the bare id with no link.

comments.body: Seen in use: the 'has finished its turn' prompt to main fires on every Stop of the worker, including mid-task pauses (pr-loop waiting on subagents, CI waits), and the pane is back to running moments later. Main gets woken for nothing. Report only when the worker stays stopped (a short grace period, re-checked) or when it sent its own report.

Rescope from main, 2026-11-26 check: (4) last message is done (doneReport, done-report.ts) and 'report only when it stays stopped' is done. (2) keyboard pane links is likely done (the link command walks every a in the entry; chat-view.ts:711-713): check by hand, only fix if not. Left: (1) it still opens in searchOverlay (chat-workers-view.ts:3), anchor it to the count; (3) no refresh on exit (ponytail note at chat-workers-view.ts:12); (5) pane claim returns the bare id (actions/pane/claim.ts:47).
Pull request #396 opened: Open the workers popup above the count, and refresh it when a worker's agent exits https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/396

Review loop: converged, ready to merge. 1 round, 3 nits fixed (popup row highlight colour, empty-list heading hint, chat-decision-10 wording), final check accepted all 3. CI passed on efab3ce9. Scope: (1) anchored popup and (3) refresh on exit done; (2) already worked, unchanged; (5) not done on purpose, workers-decision-3 keeps pane claim's bare id. Open: spawn-failure catch in pane-shells.ts skips main.ended (out of scope, #397).
